resources.string: The reticle stays white; objects near its centre highlight their existing outline without growing.
In landscape, capture stays at the bottom right; with panels collapsed, the title sits between the controls.
Photo and panorama preview controls have matching margins in portrait and landscape.
More room for object names, with Observatory and daily-path controls closer together.
A slightly lighter daytime blue is shared by buttons, links, selections and volume controls.
Selected objects use one highlighted outline, including exported photos and panoramas.
